name: Barracuda Rest/Sleep RSO Bar – Milk Chocolate
description: Barracuda Rest/Sleep Milk Chocolate Bars are crafted from the highest-quality ingredients. The chocolate is infused with RSO, one of the most versatile and lauded cannabis innovations that contains all the cannabinoids, terpenes and beneficial compounds from the entire cannabis plant. Plus, the added CBN provides sleep-inducing effects to help you unwind at the end of a long day. Each bar contains 200mg THC and RSO for a full-spectrum experience and fully activates in 1-2 hours.
